data.one_liner: Prebuilt live streaming kit with video, audio, text chat, and co-hosting support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete, ready-to-use live streaming UI component that handles realtime video and audio streaming, co-hosting, PK battles, text chat, and screen sharing with minimal configuration.
use_when: You need to quickly prototype or build live streaming functionality in your Flutter app.
You want prebuilt features like co-hosting, PK battles, virtual gifts, and screen sharing without writing them from scratch.
You want to customize UI components of a live stream via parameters and configurations.
avoid_when: You want to build a completely custom live streaming architecture from the ground up without third-party UI kits.
Your app does not require live streaming or real-time audio/video interaction.
strengths: Feature-rich out of the box including co-hosting, PK battles, beautification, and screen sharing.
Reduces development time significantly by providing prebuilt UI and logic.
Extensive configuration options and callbacks for deep customization.
weaknesses: Strict requirement for newer Android compileSdk versions (e.g., compileSdk 37).
Heavy reliance on a specific backend/service (ZEGOCLOUD ecosystem).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting compileSdk to 37 or higher on Android. Also requires handling platform permissions via permission_handler and configuring ZEGOCLOUD credentials.
data.minimal_example:
ZegoUIKitPrebuiltLiveStreaming(
  appID: yourAppID,
  appSign: yourAppSign,
  userID: yourUserID,
  userName: yourUserName,
  liveID: yourLiveID,
  config: ZegoUIKitPrebuiltLiveStreamingConfig.host(),
)
